text:
maria (support): heads up — AcmeHealth reports streaming responses that stop right after a reconnect. final JSON object never completes, no `finish_reason` field. client sees a valid partial JSON then connection closes.

acme-bug-reporter: repro steps we used: open SSE to /v1/streams with `Accept: text/event-stream`, send prompt, then trigger a proxy rotate (we use Fastly) which causes client to reconnect. after reconnect the last chunk is truncated.

acme-bug-reporter: minimal curl we used: 
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACME_KEY" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large","prompt":"hello"}' \
  https://api.redwoody.example/v1/streams
```

acme-bug-reporter: sample tail of the stream the browser got (after reconnect):
```
event: message
data: {"id":"tok_123","delta":" here is the output..."}

event: message
data: {"id":"tok_123","delta":" final part: \"done\""}

// connection closed abruptly, no terminating object, client JSON parse fails
```

maria (support): thanks — can you paste the exact headers and any request id you saw from our `x-rw-request-id` on the response? also did you see any 502 or 503 from Fastly before the reconnect?

acme-bug-reporter: x-rw-request-id: rw-8f7e2c3, x-fastly-request-id: fx-44b12. Fastly reported `TLS session renewed` at the same time, no 5xx. the client did a `resend` with an `rws-resume-token` header on reconnect.

kevin (sre): pinging eng-runtime. this smells like resume logic merging an incomplete buffer — maybe KV cache offset off by one. attaching proxy logs and our edge traces: `edge-conn-1779112233.trace` shows connection 432 close then new conn 433 open, websocket-like keepalive overlap ~200ms.

olivia (eng-runtime): can you include the raw bytes around the reconnection? also which runtime variant and model? we had a patch last month to send an end sentinel event `event: done\ndata: {"finish_reason":"stop"}` but that should be unaffected by resume code.

acme-bug-reporter: runtime: `serve-2026-1`, model: `redwood-l2`, bytes (hexdump around cut):
```
2f 65 76 65 6e 74 3a 20 6d 65 73 73 61 67 65 0a 64 61 74 61 3a 20 7b 22 69 64 22 3a 22 74 6f 6b 5f 31 32 33 22 2c 22 64 65 6c 74 61 22 3a 22 20 66 69 6e 61 6c 20
// then truncated mid-json, stream closes at 0x7f
```

olivia (eng-runtime): ok this shows a hard cut inside a JSON value. couple hypotheses: (1) our resume header handler is not replaying the last event boundary (we're trimming a trailing newline that acts as terminator), (2) edge proxy buffers and drops final bytes during TLS session handover, or (3) the client-side reconnect logic reuses an internal buffer and sends a `Range`/`resume` offset that is off-by-one.

maria (support): customer is blocked in prod. what's the temporary mitigation?

kevin (sre): ask them to disable client-side `resume` (if possible) so reconnects open a fresh request (no resume header). also increase server-side keepalive and set `Connection: keep-alive` to reduce reconnect frequency during deployments.

olivia (eng-runtime): engineering action items:
- add extra end-sentinel emit on connection close (best-effort `event: done` before socket close) to reduce parse failures on client side.
- add extra validation in resume path: if resume offset points into an event body, rewind to previous event boundary (look for last `\n\n` before offset).
- log full `rws-resume-token` and computed offsets for the failing request id (rw-8f7e2c3).

kevin (sre): I'll pull Fastly config to see TLS handoff settings and increase grace period. also enabling `streaming-heartbeat: true` so proxy won't close quick.

acme-bug-reporter: quick test for us: after you push the boundary fix, we'll repro by forcing edge rotate. do you want us to send a test key?

maria (support): yes please, we'll coordinate a maintenance window. olivia, assign a small PR for the resume-bounds check and the best-effort done-emitter. include unit tests that simulate mid-event resume offsets.

olivia (eng-runtime): got it. I'll open PR referencing rw-8f7e2c3 and include repro harness. ETA end of day. tagging @sse-bot to capture followups.

sse-bot: noted. follow-up created: INC-2026-2741 — "resume-handler: avoid truncating mid-event on reconnect". priority P1 for customer-impact.

maria (support): thanks everyone. I'll update AcmeHealth with the mitigation (disable resume) and ETA for a fix. we'll re-open this thread after PR is merged and we validate in staging. :thumbsup:
